name: mstack
description: Mark Hallam's skills for people and their AI agents, agent agnostic, switching on by themselves when relevant: ping-me (on by default: notifies you when your decision is needed or a task is done), outcome-first (asks everything once, then runs to a verified outcome), multi-evaluator (independent AI design review until every journey scores 10 out of 10), and mstack (the index, on and off switches, and private self-improvement).
